## Checklist

- [ ] One task, atomic commits, Conventional Commits
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:cov` (100%) and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] A new runtime dependency is justified here, with its license (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD or ISC)
- [ ] Tools stay read-only, and text that comes from a site's visitors is returned as data
- [ ] The token never reaches a log, an error message or a tool result
- [ ] Behavior verified with a real MCP client against a Pyxis API
- [ ] README and ADRs updated when touched
